headline.text: It grows on one repeatable list format, and a single pricing post brought most of the year's jump.
headline.basis: radar.json lift and follower pull; the 72 h gain after p087

mechanisms.title: A list format with a number in the hook
mechanisms.text: Three mistakes beats the account's own baseline about 3x.

mechanisms.title: The same backdrop every time
mechanisms.text: Every three-mistakes video opens on a screenshot behind the speaker.

did_not_work.title: The founder diary fades
did_not_work.text: A quarter of the posts are diaries, and the later ones sit well under the earlier ones.

did_not_work.title: Long one-take stories
did_not_work.text: Four of the five flops are long stories.

comment_tactics.text: A word in the caption turns comments into a lead list.

plays.title: Run your own three-mistakes series
plays.what: Three numbered mistakes in under 30 s, screenshot behind you.
plays.basis: the format's lift and hit rate
plays.dont_copy: their face and their customer stories
plays.prompt:
Write three 25-second scripts in the three-mistakes format for my product.
One mistake per beat, a fix at the end.

plays.title: Ask for one word
plays.what: Close with a one-word ask that sends a checklist.
plays.prompt: Write a caption that ends with: Comment PLAN and I'll send it.
